sermon.title: Jesus' Goals — April 3, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus came to call sinners to repentance, seek and save the lost, fulfill the law, serve and give His life, bring judgment, do the Father’s will and preach the gospel to the poor. A typical Jesus gathering does the same, and believers carry it on.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 40:22 after worship.
